jobs.title: Electronic parts inspection & assembly (seated, individual work)
jobs.hours: 8:30-17:30 (8 hours of actual work, 60-min break, day shift)
jobs.off: Saturdays and Sundays, Golden Week, summer holidays, year-end and New Year holidays
jobs.description:
Assemble and inspect small electronic parts one by one at your own workbench. Seated, individual work — not an assembly line. Great for people who enjoy detailed handiwork (accessories, nail art, crafts). No heavy lifting, no oil. Female staff are also active here.
※Japanese comprehension of 70% or more is required (work and safety instructions are given in Japanese).
jobs.remarks:
[Requirement] Japanese comprehension 70%+ / No experience needed / Soldering or electronics assembly experience welcome
[Benefits] Transportation allowance (per rules) / Salary advance available / Full social insurance / Paid leave / Car or motorbike commuting OK
Employment type: dispatched worker (Step Up Co., Ltd. / dispatch license 派22-300880)
Process: contact by e-mail or phone → interview → factory visit → start. Feel free to contact us just to talk.
